changelog: Challans Per A4 Page Setting: Added user-selectable layout configuration for 1, 2, or 3 challans per A4 page across both 2-copy and 3-copy modes (defaulting to 3 per page).
Dynamic Print Heights & Page Breaks: Automatically adjusts vertical container heights, card padding, and QR code sizing based on selected challans-per-page option with exact page-break rules.
Enhanced Report Modals: Integrated side-by-side print layout settings into Bulk Fee Challans and Range Fee Challans report modals.
